policy: Only AGOT chapter rows, captured once. Collaborative chronology, not canonical dates, coordinates, road geometry or a replacement for book evidence.

rows.title: Prologue
rows.referenceNotes: 9 days from the Wall, (may take up to 14 on the way back). Royce has been a ranger for half a year
rows.allocationRationale: About 6 months as a ranger + 9 days reaching this far north

rows.title: Daenerys
rows.referenceNotes: Dany is 13

rows.title: Daenerys
rows.referenceNotes: Mormont has been their "constant companion", "the day of the wedding came at last". Khalasar arrives
rows.allocationRationale: Unclear where Drogo's khalasar was and thus how long they took to reach Pentos. I have it as 33 days

rows.title: Daenerys
rows.event: Reaches the Dothraki sea, Rhaego concieved. Later Dany turns 14 and is visibly pregnant
rows.referenceNotes: Dany turns 14. Khalasar left Pentos the day after the wedding. Pentos -> Norvos hills -> half a moon in Qohor's forests -> Dothraki sea
rows.allocationRationale: Chapter starts 75 days after Dany 2 and ends 90 days later (see the notes). As per a SSM Jon is 8-9 months older than Dany, this would place her birthday at about day 191. Dany's marriage and pregnancy don't synch well with Robert getting news of it.
rows.notes: Traveling by Valyrian roads should be fast. Based on the map, Pentos to the Dothraki Sea is 4 to 5 times longer than the Qohor forest road (2/2.5 months total). "On the far side of the Dothraki sea" when she's visibly pregnant, should be ~3 months after impregnation. As per Dany 9 Rhaego was concieved when they first reached the Dothraki Sea, thus "far side" means far east and the chapter spans 3 months

rows.title: Bran
rows.referenceNotes: Bran is 7, Theon is 19, Jon is 14
rows.allocationRationale: Same day as Cat 1

rows.title: Catelyn
rows.referenceNotes: Rickon is 3, Tommen is 7. Lysa left KL
rows.allocationRationale: Raven time (11 days) from KL sent 1 day after Arryn died

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: Sweetrobin is 6, Sansa is 11
rows.allocationRationale: (Slow) Travel time between KL and WF, based on the journey south (currently at 65 days)

rows.title: Jon
rows.referenceNotes: Myrcella is 7 (see the comments sheet), Joff is 12, "Father took Robert to the crypts this afternoon"
rows.allocationRationale: Same day as Ned 1
rows.notes: Robert's journey north is more than long enough for Benjen and Mance to reach WF

rows.title: Catelyn
rows.event: Message from Lysa, Ned decides to go south
rows.referenceNotes: Benjen talked to Luwin "a few days ago" Jon 1. Ned leaving south in a fortnight
rows.allocationRationale: A few (5) days after Jon 1
rows.notes: Robert's journey north is more than long enough for Lysa to send her message in time to catch up

rows.title: Arya
rows.referenceNotes: Arya is 9, Robb is 14
rows.allocationRationale: Some days (9) after Robert arrived

rows.title: Bran
rows.referenceNotes: Bran is 7. Leaving tomorrow
rows.allocationRationale: A fortnight + a hunt after Cat 2 (16 days)

rows.title: Tyrion
rows.referenceNotes: Bran in a coma for 4 days
rows.allocationRationale: 4 days after Bran 2

rows.title: Jon
rows.referenceNotes: Cat has been by Bran's side "close on a fortnight"
rows.allocationRationale: Nearly a fortnight (13 days) after Bran 2

rows.title: Catelyn
rows.event: Assassin to kill Bran, decides to go to KL
rows.referenceNotes: Robb is 14, "Ned and the girls were eight days gone", sleeps for 4 days
rows.allocationRationale: Starts 8 days after Jon 2. Spans 4 days

rows.title: Daenerys
rows.referenceNotes: Has a "big belly". Feels Rhaego moving
rows.allocationRationale: An average of 18 weeks until babies can be felt moving - about 6 weeks (46 days) after Dany 3

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: In the Barrowlands. Rider from KL with news of Dany 2
rows.allocationRationale: At least 8 (15) days between WF and Barrowlands

rows.title: Tyrion
rows.referenceNotes: 18 days into the journey
rows.allocationRationale: 18 days after Jon 2

rows.title: Catelyn
rows.referenceNotes: Rode to White Harbor, winds against them but the ship was fast. Petyr has no news of Darry yet (but him & Cat do by Ned 4)
rows.allocationRationale: Time to get to WH (15 days), time to reach KL (14 days), having left some time (7 days) after Cat 3.

rows.title: Sansa
rows.event: Barristan, Renly and Ilyn arrive from KL, Joff attacked
rows.referenceNotes: "Looking forward to this day for more than a week", crossing the Neck took 12 days
rows.allocationRationale: About 3/4 through their journey. Currently as 56 days after Jon 2, see the notes
rows.notes: Based on the map, WF to Moat Cailin appears to be as long as Moat Cailin to Riverlands (11 days) and Neck to Ruby Ford and Darry To KL (14 days - Ned 4). This should make Robert's journey about 60 days. I have increased it to about 75 because of Jon's nameday

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: "seaching for Arya for 4 days"
rows.allocationRationale: 4 days after Sansa 1

rows.title: Bran
rows.referenceNotes: Sees Cat sailing in the Bite and Ned at Darry
rows.allocationRationale: Connected to other chapters, see Comments and Connected chapters
rows.notes: Not necessarily contemporary with Ned 3 as dreams are rarely contiguous, especially since Bran is out for several months. Then again these are magic dreams

rows.title: Jon
rows.event: Learns that Bran has woken up
rows.allocationRationale: Raven time (3 days) after Bran 3

rows.title: Tyrion
rows.referenceNotes: Jon has been training with Grenn and Pyp and has spent several days on duty since angering Thorne
rows.allocationRationale: Some time (2 days) after Jon 3
rows.notes: Tyrion needs to leave quickly in order to meet with Cat on time

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: "The last fortnight of their journey had been a misery"
rows.allocationRationale: At least a fortnight (17 days) after Ned 3

rows.title: Bran
rows.referenceNotes: Bran is 8. Tyrion and Yoren leaving south tomorrow
rows.allocationRationale: Winterfell is about a third (7 days) of the way through Tyrion's (22 day long) journey
rows.notes: Bran has a dream between meeting Tyrion and the feast with Yoren, however there is no mention of nighttime and Tyrion said they would leave at daybreak.

rows.title: Arya
rows.event: Sad about Mycah. Has her first lesson with Syrio
rows.referenceNotes: Ned has been dining with the king, lords, envoys, sometimes his daughters. His men have silver hand pins on their cloaks. Chapter spans 5 days. No news of Bran 4
rows.allocationRationale: Some time after Ned 4 (6 days). Spans 4 days
rows.notes: Ned has seemingly had many dinners in the capitol but this chapter needs take place as shortly after Ned 4 as possible so Ned can learn that Bran has woken up. How long would it take to forge 50 silver hand pins?

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: Learned of Bran waking up some time prior to this chapter (after Arya 2)
rows.allocationRationale: Got news of Bran 3 several (3) days ago

rows.title: Catelyn
rows.referenceNotes: Mallister riding south. "At King's Landing a fortnight ago"
rows.allocationRationale: A fortnight (18 days, rounding down) after leaving KL in Ned 4

rows.title: Jon
rows.referenceNotes: "for every day spent hunting he gave a dozen to Noye in the armory" - has probably observed this at least twice, he made no mention of hunting last chapter. Sam joins them for a meal "a few nights later", another fortnight before he speaks up
rows.allocationRationale: At least 26 days after Jon 3. Chapter spans a fortnight + several days (20 total)
rows.notes: Mormont sent the Halfhand and Ryker to find Benjen, they found nothing - shouldn't have taken more than the 26 days we already have

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: Jory thinks Stannis can return on time for the tourney
rows.allocationRationale: Robert announced the tourney the same day they reached KL. Time for Beric (4 days of raven time + 16 riding on the kingsroad) to arrive

rows.title: Sansa
rows.referenceNotes: 100 pavilions have been raised and the smallfolk have come by the thousands. Mallister is here. Tourney will continue tomorrow
rows.allocationRationale: Gave Mallister time (7 days) to get to KL after Cat 5 Also gave Stannis enough time (5 days) to hypothetically arive after Ned 6
rows.notes: Mallister being here is probably a mistake on GRRM's part as it's inconsistent with Yoren's claim. Still, as presented in the text Mallister is 100% in both chapters, while Yoren could be lying

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: Tyrek is 12 (see the comments sheet), Margaery is 14. Mya Stone 17/18. Arya catching cats tomorrow
rows.allocationRationale: 1 day after Sansa 2

rows.title: Daenerys
rows.referenceNotes: "Tender stomach" for the past 2 months (did not mention it last chapter)
rows.allocationRationale: At least 60 days after Dany 4 (90)
rows.notes: Next chapter Illyrio has told them of the poison, but doesn't know that Viserys is dead, so I've added another 30 days for a total of 90

rows.title: Arya
rows.referenceNotes: Margaery is 14. Chasing cats day and night, caught all but Balerion. Cat has taken Tyrion, Dany is pregnant. Yoren arrives
rows.allocationRationale: Catching all the cats probably warrants 2-7 days (3)

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: Met Yoren last night. Pycelle has invited Stannis back
rows.allocationRationale: 1 day after Arya 3. Stannis has had 10 days to respond to a letter sent after Ned 6
rows.notes: Pycelle sent a letter inviting Stannis back (presumably after Ned 6, Ned would have mentioned it to Jory otherwise). Stannis has remained silent (he's had time to repsond)

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: Same day as Ned 8. Jaime says Tywin is "quite vexed" about Tyrion's capture
rows.allocationRationale: Same day as Ned 8. The night of this day is the first of the 7 nights mentioned in Ned 10
rows.notes: Jaime is implying he learned of Tyrion's capture via Tywin

rows.title: Eddard
rows.event: Wakes up in the night. Robert hunting tomorrow
rows.referenceNotes: Slept 6 days and 7 nights. Robert hunting tomorrow
rows.allocationRationale: Night 1 was the night of Ned 9. Day 6 and night 7 are the day of this chapter as Ned wakes up in the night. (6 days after Ned 9)

rows.title: Tyrion
rows.event: On the road. Attacked by clansmen
rows.referenceNotes: "By now out pursuit is likely racing across the Neck"
rows.allocationRationale: Raven time to CR (6 days) + riding time (24 days) for their potential pursuit to be in the Neck by now

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: Edmure and Tywin gathering men. Robert may not return for days
rows.allocationRationale: Time for the refugees and the knights to reach KL (11 days)
rows.notes: Jaime knows that Tywin knows of Tyrion's capture (Ned 9). Gregor was with his men on the Goldroad shortly after the tourney (Arya 7 ACOK). This possibly means that Tywin sent a raven to KL after learning of Cat5, informing Jaime and Gregor of Tyrion's capture. (If Gregor is given enough time to get to Tywin before burning the villages, Robert's death will be pushed into 299)

rows.title: Sansa
rows.event: Ned sending the girls north. Beric leaves
rows.referenceNotes: Same days as Ned 11
rows.allocationRationale: Starts the same day as Ned 11. Spans 2 days

rows.title: Catelyn
rows.referenceNotes: Sweetrobin is 6, Mya is 17/18. Clansmen have attacked. Cat intends to send Ned's message of war north and warn Hoster
rows.allocationRationale: 1 day between attacks and another before Morrec dies? (3 days total). Chapter spans 2 days

rows.title: Bran
rows.referenceNotes: Robb is 15, has received Cat's message of war. Learned of Ned9 yesterday. Considers calling the banners
rows.allocationRationale: Letter from KL sent before Ned woke up (sent on day 336 with 22 days raven time to arrive yesterday). Letter from Eyrie sent after Cat 6 ended (sent on day 352 with 6 days of raven time to arrive yesterday)
rows.notes: Bran has had plenty of time learn how to ride and ask the Wall for news of Benjen

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: Tywin sent a letter to Cersei, angry about Ned 11. Arya and Sansa leaving in 3 days
rows.allocationRationale: Raven time between KL and CR and back (5+5=10 days total after Ned 11)

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: Robert returns in the night. "It had taken them 2 days to get back". Sansa and Arya leaving in the evening (tomorrow). Thinks the Lannister host is ready to attack
rows.allocationRationale: In the night between the 2nd and 3rd day after Ned 12, see the notes
rows.notes: Ned 12 ended well into the night and Ned 13 is well into the night and there is almost a full day before Sansa and Arya are to leave (3 days after Ned 12), ~48 hours pass between Ned 12 and 13. Thus Robert was wounded early on day 360 and the "2 days back" are 35-40 hours

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: "Brief exhaustive sleep" after Ned 13. Renly left the city. Arya off to have a lesson with Syrio
rows.allocationRationale: 1 day after Ned 13
rows.notes: Robert dies in 298 AC as per TWOIAF

rows.title: Arya
rows.referenceNotes: Same day as Ned 14
rows.allocationRationale: Same day as Ned 14

rows.title: Sansa
rows.referenceNotes: "They came for Sansa on the third day" (mentions that "the first day" was Ned 14)
rows.allocationRationale: 2 days after Ned 14

rows.title: Daenerys
rows.referenceNotes: Leaves Vaes Dothrak on the 3rd day
rows.allocationRationale: 40 days for the poison to arrive after Ned 8. Chapter spans 3 days

rows.title: Tyrion
rows.referenceNotes: Cassel's would is half-healed, trial tomorrow
rows.allocationRationale: 1 day before Cat 7

rows.title: Catelyn
rows.referenceNotes: Bird from Riverrun - Jaime amassing troops at CR
rows.allocationRationale: Raven time (7 days) for Edmure's letter

rows.title: Tyrion
rows.referenceNotes: Left the Eyrie at daybreak. Won't ride fast along the Kingsroad
rows.allocationRationale: Shortly (1 day) after Cat 7

rows.title: Daenerys
rows.allocationRationale: Time to to reach Lhazar (20 days)
rows.notes: Based on the map it should be even longer

rows.title: Daenerys
rows.referenceNotes: Drogo tore off Mirri's "bandages" 6 days ago
rows.allocationRationale: 6 + several (8 days) after Dany 7. 299 days total for her pregnancy

rows.title: Bran
rows.event: Robb leaving south on the 3rd day
rows.referenceNotes: Rickon is 3. Karstarks arrive last. Fighting in the riverlands (Mummer's Ford). Got Sansa's letter
rows.allocationRationale: Time for Karstark (and other lords) - (3 days raven time, 25 to gather their men, 16 to reach WF - 44 days since summoned, after Bran 6). Chapter spans 3 days
rows.notes: "Willas and Garlan can raise ten thousand men within a fortnight and twice that in a moon's turn" - Cersei 7 AFFC

rows.title: Jon
rows.referenceNotes: Arya is still 9
rows.allocationRationale: Shortly before Jon 6 (1 day)

rows.title: Jon
rows.allocationRationale: Soon before Jon 7 (1 day)

rows.title: Jon
rows.referenceNotes: "Close on half a year since Benjen left". Letter from Pycelle - Robert dead and Ned jailed. Jeor to send a raven tomorrow asking for Ned to take the black
rows.allocationRationale: Nearly half a year (158 days) after Benjen left

rows.title: Catelyn
rows.referenceNotes: Robb "has been waiting for Manderly"
rows.allocationRationale: 16 days of travel time for Robb and his army + 3 days waiting. 10 days for Cat & Manderly's army

rows.title: Sansa
rows.allocationRationale: Several days (8) before Ned 15

rows.title: Tyrion
rows.referenceNotes: Pinkmaiden and Stone Hedge burned, Raventree fallen, Harrenhal yielded. Robb leaving Moat Cailin
rows.allocationRationale: Time to learn of Cat 8 (5 days), which leaves 60 days for Tywin to capture all the castles after the Mummer's Ford

rows.title: Eddard
rows.referenceNotes: Hasn't eaten. Tyrion free, Robb "marches down the Neck". Will speak with Cersei tomorrow
rows.allocationRationale: 4 days of raven time after Tyrion 7. Jeor's letter has probably arrived (27 days)
rows.notes: With adequate water intake you can make it without food for up to 2 months before starving to death

rows.title: Catelyn
rows.event: At The Twins. Walders sent north, Roose down the Kingsroad. Robb & cavalary to Riverrun
rows.referenceNotes: Big Walder is 8. Tywin marching north. Day 2 - news of the battle of Riverrun. Walder knows that Tywin is hand
rows.allocationRationale: Robb's journey through the Neck should be roughly about as long as Robert's (17 days). Walder has had 17 days to potentially learn of Sansa 5. Spans 2 days
rows.notes: Walder may be referencing Tywin serving as hand for Aerys

rows.title: Tyrion
rows.event: Meets Shae. Battle of the Green Fork
rows.referenceNotes: Marched all day. Nearly a year since he left KL
rows.allocationRationale: Marching up the kingsroad (15 days). Chapter spans 2 days

rows.title: Arya
rows.referenceNotes: Thought her ship had left "ages ago"
rows.allocationRationale: At least 1 (11 days) after Ned 15

rows.title: Jon
rows.referenceNotes: Jeor sent 2 men to look for Benjen, they have returned. Barristan dismissed, Robb marching south
rows.allocationRationale: Raven time after Sansa 5 (20 days), leaving 26 days for the rangers to go north looking for Benjen and return.

rows.title: Daenerys
rows.event: Wakes up from her fever. Smothers Drogo
rows.referenceNotes: Sick for a long time. Chapter spans 2 days
rows.allocationRationale: Some time before Dany 10 (15 days). Chapter spans 2 days. This makes her sickness last 47 days

rows.title: Catelyn
rows.allocationRationale: Robb's force is all cavalary, they should be able to quickly (13 days) march south. Spans 2 days
rows.notes: Cat thinks Ned was still alive during this battle in Cat 5 ASOS. She could be wrong

rows.title: Catelyn
rows.referenceNotes: Hoster watched the battle last night. Cat just learned of Ned's death. Renly is king, Green Fork
rows.allocationRationale: Same day as the Camps. 13 days for news of Ned's death, 9 for Renly, 12 for Green Fork

rows.title: Jon
rows.referenceNotes: Knows of Ned's death (presumably just learned)
rows.allocationRationale: 17 days of raven time since Ned died. Chapter spans 2 days

rows.title: Sansa
rows.referenceNotes: Slept several times since Ned's death. Joff's nameday will be soon. Knows of the whispering wood
rows.allocationRationale: Raven time after Cat 10 (3 days) to have arrived some time (2 days) ago

rows.title: Tyrion
rows.event: Back at the inn. Tywin to Harrenhal. Gregor, Amory and Vargo to pillage. Tyrion to KL
rows.referenceNotes: Fast messenger with news of the camps. Spent last night at the inn. Ned dead, Jonos a lord, Renly king
rows.allocationRationale: Time for a messenger to arrive after the camps (5 days). Days (16) of forced march back to the inn after Tyrion 8 + at least 1 day spent here (17 total)

rows.title: Daenerys
rows.event: Comet appears in the evening. Dragons hatch
rows.allocationRationale: 1st day of the comet being visible

rows.title: Bran
rows.referenceNotes: Rickon is 4. Rodrik has returned. Raven with news of Ned's death
rows.allocationRationale: Raven time (10 days) after Cat 11, see the notes
rows.notes: Jon makes no mention of the comet in Jon 9. Pycelle is mentioned to have sent CB letters but not  WF. So maybe Jon got the news directly from KL, while Bran only learned it via Riverrun from Robb (after Robb's coronation, Bran knows Robb is king next chapter)
